text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am interested in renting the 1800 Sport for a weekend getaway. The vehicle will be required on 30th April 2027, with collection from your garage scheduled for 11:00 am and return by 7.30pm. It would be helpful to have the vehicle supplied with a picnic hamper.

I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Best regards,
Kit Braithwell
+70 678 214 1791
